notes.subject: ol sesaven wantaim save
notes.rationale: Lain bilong tok i hat: KJV/BSB ol i putim 'wisdom and knowledge' olsem hed, JPS/YLT ol i putim 'hoard of salvation'; Hebriu i no tok klia olsem wanem tok i holim wanem

notes.subject: ples bilong lukautim bilong em
notes.rationale: אוצרו: 'stor bilong em' (Yahwe) o 'stor bilong yu' (Zion/ol man) — sofo ikim 'his', ASV 'thy'

translation: Na bilibeli tru bilong ol taim bilong yu i kamap gutpela samting bilong holim — ol sesaven, save, na save long olgeta samting; bikpela respekt long Yahwe, em i ples bilong lukautim olgeta samting bilong em.
